Trump Administration Faces Court Rejections and Policy Challenges

The Trump administration has experienced a series of setbacks, with courts rejecting its plans to obtain state voter rolls, resulting in a 0-26 losing record for the Department of Justice. Additionally, the administration's favored economic scorecard is reportedly heading in the wrong direction weeks before the midterms. In a separate development concerning immigration, a new 'America First' initiative could bar immigrants from health insurance tax credits, and the administration has also canceled hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments, though some individuals are being added back.
